candidate.name: Ignacio Arsuaga
candidate.startAvailability: Target start availability: late August to early September 2026, subject to USCIS approval and EAD issuance

hero.label: Made for Love Querencia
hero.headline: I want to help Love Querencia grow its first partnerships.
hero.subheadline: Love Querencia sits at the intersection of wellness, community, and purposeful living, which is exactly the kind of mission I want to build something around. The Business Development Partner role is a chance to be the person who opens doors, not just fills a pipeline, and that distinction matters to me. I am ready to bring real outreach experience and genuine belief in what this company stands for.

whyCompany.title: Love Querencia builds belonging, not just a product
whyCompany.body: The name itself signals intention. 'Querencia' refers to a place from which one draws strength, and a brand built around that idea has a story worth telling to every potential partner. That kind of mission-driven positioning makes business development conversations easier and more honest, which is how I like to operate.

whyCompany.title: Early-stage means the first BD hires shape everything
whyCompany.body: Joining at this moment means the outreach playbook, the partner profiles, and the relationship infrastructure do not exist yet and get to be built by the people coming in now. That is not a challenge to survive, it is a creative opportunity. I want to be in the room where those foundational decisions get made.

whyCompany.title: I have done exactly this kind of zero-to-one outreach before
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach sequences through HubSpot and LinkedIn and helped the company close 10 to 12 paying clients from scratch, which means I know what it takes to build a pipeline before there is brand awareness doing the heavy lifting. At NextAfter I then worked inside a B2B consultancy studying what messaging actually converts, which sharpened how I think about every touchpoint. Love Querencia deserves outreach that reflects its values, and I know how to make that happen.

quote: I am not looking for a role where I execute someone else's script. I want to be the person who figures out who Love Querencia should be talking to, earns those conversations, and makes the company bigger because I showed up.
